description.en: Create advanced automations with entity triggers, attribute conditions, metadata-driven commands, visual sequences, nested branches, waits, delays, HTTP requests, reusable blueprints and raw JSON editing.

value.en: Run Advanced Automations directly on a Remote or as an external integration. The automation editor starts at port 9201 and scans upward if that port is occupied. During setup, enter the Remote address and Web Configurator PIN. The integration authenticates as web-configurator, creates a persistent admin API key through the official Unfolded Circle Core REST API, stores only that key, and discards the PIN.
